difficultyRationale: Checks the exact text rule used by Boolean.parseBoolean rather than relying on common truthy-string conventions from other languages.
prompt: Which strings cause `Boolean.parseBoolean(value)` to return `true`? Select all that apply.
explanation: `Boolean.parseBoolean` returns true exactly when the argument is non-null and equals `"true"` ignoring case.

options.explanation: Mixed case also matches because case is ignored.
The method does not treat `yes` as a true value.
